Behaviour and accessibility

          
    
            
  • Copy uses navigator.clipboard; if blocked, the value is selected and the button says “Press ⌘C”. “Copied” shows for 1.8 s.
    • 
            
  • List copy buttons carry aria-label="Copy MCP server URL" so screen readers name the value.
    • 
            
  • Download, pop-up: opens Marketo form marketoFormId in a dialog (role="dialog", aria-modal), focus on the first field, Esc and backdrop close it, focus returns to the button.
    • 
            
  • Download, inline: smooth-scrolls to formAnchor and focuses the first field.
    • 
            
  • Values, prompts and code are real text, never images.
    • 
            
  • Focus ring: 2 px hds-object-focused, outside the control. Respects prefers-reduced-motion.
    •

Every preview on this page is drawn by these two files. Use them as the reference for the Next.js component.

src/cta/dx-cta.jsMarkup per composition and action, copy behaviour, pop-up and inline form
